title: Tuk Tuk Auto Rhyme | Manipuri Kids Song for Kids, Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Hop into the Tuk Tuk Auto and go with Amma!
This happy rhyme teaches little ones to wait for the red light, then go on the green.
Sing along and learn to stay safe on the road!

תּוּק תּוּק אוטוֹ, חַכּוּ הַמָּקוֹם, בִּיפּ בִּיפּ — טוּק טוּק אַטוֹ, הַחֲזִיקוּ חָזָק, בִּיפּ בִּיפּ
תּוּק תּוּק אוטו, תִּחְזִיקוּ חָזָק, בִּיפּ בִּיפּ
